description: NaTbO₂ crystallizes in the tetragonal I4₁/amd space group. Na¹⁺ is bonded to six O²⁻ atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent TbO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, edges with four equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with eight equivalent TbO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-14°. There are four shorter (2.32 Å) and two longer (2.86 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Tb³⁺ is bonded to six O²⁻ atoms to form TbO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent TbO₆ octahedra, edges with four equivalent TbO₆ octahedra, and edges with eight equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-14°. There are two shorter (2.29 Å) and four longer (2.32 Å) Tb-O bond lengths. There are four inequivalent O²⁻ sites. In the first O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded to three equivalent Na¹⁺ and three equivalent Tb³⁺ atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₃Tb₃ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-14°. In the second O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded to three equivalent Na¹⁺ and three equivalent Tb³⁺ atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₃Tb₃ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-14°. In the third O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded to three equivalent Na¹⁺ and three equivalent Tb³⁺ atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₃Tb₃ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-14°. There is one shorter (2.29 Å) and two longer (2.32 Å) O-Tb bond lengths. In the fourth O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded to three equivalent Na¹⁺ and three equivalent Tb³⁺ atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₃Tb₃ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-14°. There are two shorter (2.32 Å) and one longer (2.86 Å) O-Na bond length.
